accept: Keep the retained handler: it consults the live editor on every use, so Rename still records a name when allowed, refuses while read-only and works again when permission returns.
A different implementation that checks the current authority at invocation is equivalent; replacing the command on menu open is unnecessary.
edit-action-stale.reject: Capture editable at installation or disable Rename permanently: one allows edits after revocation, the other loses the ordinary action after permission returns.
edit-action-stale.limit: Unit: retained app closure and its recorded names, not UIKit menu delivery.

accept: Ship the native labeled slider; its binding, bounds and step already express the requested behavior.
Retain the slider and binding. Discuss a localized value description as optional only if a distinct product requirement calls for it.
native-slider.reject: Replace it with a static spoken value, add a separately focusable duplicate title, or require a custom modifier to repair an unobserved announcement.
native-slider.limit: Source-grade the accessibility decision; native typechecking does not measure speech, stops or user experience.

accept: With automatic criteria enabled and a previous manual override on this group, keep the call: Follow System delegates choice to the player for this group; it does not promise silence or a particular track.
An equivalent button that invokes the automatic selection API directly is valid. Do not guess which option the system will select.
automatic-vs-off.reject: Clear the group with select(nil,in:) or promise automatic selection always produces a specific current option.
automatic-vs-off.limit: SDK typecheck and source review of the installed button path. An injected closure alone would not establish AVPlayerItem selection.
